files.content:
# RSM export module layout

`src/rsm.json.j2` is intentionally a thin orchestrator. Mapping logic is split into `src/fields/*.j2`.

Each field module exports `apply(ns, dc, entities, replies)` and mutates `ns.root`.

Maintenance rule: put derivation/normalization logic in the module for the RSM field it controls. `_refs.j2` contains KM UUIDs; `_helpers.j2` contains generic DSW reply helpers.

Order is significant only where documented (for example `distribution_channels` may inspect already-built `registries`).


## Identifier-link policy

All resolvable identifiers are emitted as full links where the RSM field permits strings: DOI (`https://doi.org/...`), ORCID (`https://orcid.org/...`), ROR (`https://ror.org/...`), SPDX (`https://spdx.org/licenses/...`, without `.html`), EDAM ontology URIs, Crossref funder DOI URLs, SWH archive URLs, PMID and PMCID URLs.

## JSON text / escaping policy

This template is a data exporter, not an HTML renderer. `_helpers.j2` marks reply
values and KM labels as safe *before* constructing the Python/Jinja objects, so
DSW's HTML autoescape cannot turn `&` into `&`, `<` into `<`, etc.
The final `tojson` call is solely responsible for valid JSON escaping.

## Jinja loop state

Persistent selections made inside loops must use `namespace()`. Ordinary Jinja
variables assigned inside a loop are loop-scoped and disappear afterward.
`quality_and_manager.j2` deliberately uses namespaces for formatter, linter,
type-checker, and project-manager selection.

## Development status

`development_status` is derived from `dc.current_phase` in the objectified DSW
document context. `to_context_obj` uses snake_case attributes; raw
`project.phaseUuid` must not be accessed as `dc.project.phaseUuid`.

Mapping:
- Ideation -> `concept`
- Planning -> `wip`
- Active development -> `active`
- Maintenance -> `active`, except when the SMP explicitly says Updates & maintenance = No, then `unsupported`

## RSM schema / KM update in 1.2.0

- The RSM schema now has root `topics.entries[]` for EDAM Topic terms.
- The SMP `Keywords` list is split by reply kind:
  - selected EDAM Topic integration result -> `topics.entries[]` with `term` + full EDAM `uri`
  - custom/free-text reply -> `keywords.entries[]`
- The SMP Functions structure now has explicit `Input data & formats` and
  `Output data & formats` list items.
- Each function I/O item maps to RSM `function_io`:
  - EDAM Data selection/custom reply -> `data`
  - linked global Data formats -> `format[]`

readme:
# RSM Schema JSON export

Exports `lumc:research-smp:1.0.0` questionnaire replies to RSM Schema 1.0.0 JSON.
RSM Schema data is compatible with Research Software Tools - a workspace where files and repository scaffolds can be generated.
